results.detail: Drive opens driving-ready: the program is already running and there is no Run button to find
bar: Back to build · Buggy · Test plate (on) / My world · Reset; the line: "Drag the joystick or use the arrow keys"
the test plate has its course: fence-ahead, fence-behind, fence-right, fence-left, post-right, post-left, post-far
the drawer, the command strip, the camera cluster and the robotics panel are out of the way
the framing counts the bar (top 67 px) and the speed/hint/joystick column (right 287 px); nothing covers the bottom or the left
the whole fenced course is on screen clear of every control (margins {"left":110,"right":109,"top":95,"bottom":99} px) and the robot's 6-stud plate is drawn 97 px wide
dragging the knob up (92 % up) drove it 9.1 studs forward at 8.2 studs/s (readout "Speed8.2studs a second"), turning -0.1°
letting go: the knob springs back and the motors stop (speed 0.00 studs/s)
ArrowLeft held 0.8 s: it turned 67° to the left on the spot (moved 2.7 studs); the knob leans left while the key is held
ArrowRight turned it back -60°; W drove it 4.3 studs forward
after the drag and the keys the page has not scrolled or zoomed (scroll 0,0; scale 1)
Reset: back where it started (0.000 from the built pose), driving-ready again
My world: no course, the student's 3 scenery bricks stay drawn by the studio (only the robot's 9 bricks are the stage's), and the robot is free to roll
ArrowUp in My world drove it 6.3 studs forward among the student's bricks
Test plate again: the course is back and it is driving-ready
Back to build: every brick, cable, name and creation (run space included) is exactly as built; 0 programs saved; Undo stack unchanged (16); the stage is closed
the build tools are back
taking a wheel off while it drives closes Drive: the construction is the truth
